IS 4392 : 2024 Textiles - Hand-Made Namdhas - Specification
ICS 97.150
ICS 97.150
TXD 04
TXD 04
1 SCOPE
This standard prescribes the requirements of three grades of hand-made patterned and embroidered namdhas. However, this does not specify the general appearance, design, etc of these namdhas (see also 4.1).
2 REFERENCES
The standards given below contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provision of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of these standards:
